parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.0081) as it regressed from my best (1.0049). The jump to LR 0.04 might have been too aggressive for this stability level. Reverting to DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.03, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. Next, I'll try a more cautious increment to MATRIX_LR=0.035 to see if we can find a middle ground.
parsed.description: Testing a smaller increment of MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.035 to find a better learning rate while maintaining the stability of the current best config.
